# a lone dot becomes a cross and back
B 1 -60 0 minecraft:redstone_wire[east=side,north=side,power=0,south=side,west=side]

B 1 -60 0 minecraft:redstone_wire[east=side,north=side,power=0,south=side,west=side]
# adventure players cannot toggle

# a block item in hand is not placed when the click toggles, but is placed by a click that does not

B 5 -60 6 minecraft:redstone_wire[east=side,north=side,power=0,south=side,west=side]
B 5 -59 6 minecraft:stone
I Alice 0 minecraft:stone*4
